name: MLGym
intro: MLGym是首个面向机器学习任务的Gym环境，支持大型语言模型代理的评估与开发。它包含13个多样化且开放式的AI研究任务，涵盖计算机视觉、自然语言处理和强化学习等领域，旨在促进对AI研究型Agent的开发与评估。
build_method: 专家任务策展, 可配置Gym沙盒, 脚本化评测
metric: Best Attempt@4、Best Submission@4、性能剖面曲线下面积、任务专用指标
modality: 文本, 图像, 代码, 多模态
build_method_en: Expert task curation, configurable Gym sandboxing, script-based evaluation
intro_en: MLGym is the first Gym environment designed for machine learning tasks, supporting the evaluation and development of large language model agents. It includes 13 diverse and open-ended AI research tasks spanning computer vision, natural language processing, and reinforcement learning, aiming to advance the development and assessment of AI research agents.

flowchart LR
    A["Curate 13 open-ended research tasks across vision, NLP, RL, game theory, SAT, and tabular prediction"] --> B["Define datasets, starter code, read-only evaluation, artifacts, dependencies, and timeouts by configuration"]

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2502.14499, Sections 3-6, and the official Meta MLGym repository. The diagrams preserve the 13-task domain coverage, configuration fields, flexible artifact contracts, Docker-backed Gymnasium environment, non-root/read-only protections, agent tools, repeated validate versus terminal submit semantics, task-specific training timeouts, 50-interaction cap, four independent runs, Best Attempt@4/Best Submission@4 distinction, and performance-profile/AUP aggregation over heterogeneous task metrics. Both 1625 by 501 desktop exports were visually reviewed without clipping, overlap, or connector-node crossings.
